tasks.name: Owner Mode onboarding and settings
tasks.requiredOutput: Explicit enablement, persistent indicator, approval policy, data boundary, disable/reset controls.
tasks.doneWhen: User can choose full access and UI never mislabels it as sandboxed.

tasks.name: Full filesystem service
tasks.requiredOutput: Absolute paths, drives, shares, hidden files, metadata, search, copy, move, delete, and transactions in Owner Mode.
tasks.doneWhen: Cross-platform fixtures pass, including symlinks/reparse points and long paths.

tasks.name: Owner finite command execution
tasks.requiredOutput: Arbitrary direct processes with cwd/env, bounded output, cancellation, and effect records.
tasks.doneWhen: Commands run outside projects only in Owner Mode and are fully journaled.

tasks.name: Automation host technology spike
tasks.requiredOutput: Measured comparison of TypeScript/node-pty+Playwright, native/Rust PTY+Playwright, and other viable packaging options.
tasks.doneWhen: An ADR selects a solution using measured startup, memory, packaging, and reliability.

tasks.name: Interactive PTY service
tasks.requiredOutput: Shell sessions, input, resize, ANSI, attach, detach, reconnect, and transcript.
tasks.doneWhen: Interactive fixtures pass on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

tasks.name: Process-tree lifecycle manager
tasks.requiredOutput: Stable process identity, descendants, readiness, stop, kill, parent death, and PID-reuse handling.
tasks.doneWhen: No child remains after kill or timeout in adversarial tests.

tasks.name: Package and SDK operations
tasks.requiredOutput: Package install/remove/update and SDK discovery with structured receipts.
tasks.doneWhen: Fixture installers and dry-run policies pass; real smoke tests run on target images.

tasks.name: Service and application control
tasks.requiredOutput: Service status/start/stop and application open/close adapters with platform-specific implementations.
tasks.doneWhen: Supported operations return honest status and rollback notes.

tasks.name: Clipboard and screen capabilities
tasks.requiredOutput: Clipboard read/write, screen capture, active-window metadata, and redaction policy.
tasks.doneWhen: Capabilities obey profile and do not leak content into logs.

tasks.name: Best-effort host snapshots and undo
tasks.requiredOutput: File backups, Git checkpoints, restore points where available, and operation receipts.
tasks.doneWhen: Injected failures restore supported file changes and mark non-restorable effects.

tasks.name: Emergency pause and kill watchdog
tasks.requiredOutput: UI, tray, keyboard shortcut, and worker-watchdog kill paths.
tasks.doneWhen: Kill works with frozen UI, runaway output, and descendant processes.

tasks.name: Terminal UX
tasks.requiredOutput: Tabs, shell/cwd selector, search, save, copy, interrupt, terminate, attach, and run linkage.
tasks.doneWhen: Keyboard and screen-reader terminal scenarios pass.

tasks.name: Owner Mode adversarial suite
tasks.requiredOutput: Destructive-command, path-race, output-flood, fork-bomb, crash, and restart tests.
tasks.doneWhen: Effects are intended, bounded by the OS account, observable, cancellable, and recoverable where claimed.

tasks.name: Owner Mode operator guide
tasks.requiredOutput: Privileges, risk, backups, unattended mode, secrets, kill, and recovery documentation.
tasks.doneWhen: Guide matches UI and tested behavior.

exitGate: Owner Mode can access the full host available to the OS account.
Interactive terminals work on Windows, macOS, and Linux with platform-specific shell and lifecycle evidence.
Process trees can be killed reliably.
Full-host effects are observable, journaled, and recoverable where claimed.
Owner Mode is clearly distinguished from isolation.
